detail.longDescription: Most browser friction comes from the defaults: • New tab suggesting top sites → switch to a clean new tab (weather + clock + search) • URL bar as a dumb address box → set smart bookmarks, use % for tab search • Multiple browser contexts bleeding together → containers None of these cost money. All take 20 minutes to set up. https:// addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firef ox/addon/weather-clock-dashboard/ # Firefox # Productivity
